reply: {"assays":[{"name_in_paper":"experimental challenge with mosquito-borne falciparum malaria","quote":"Patterns of expressed genes in the peripheral blood mononuclear cells of persons who were receiving RTS,S/AS01 or RTS,S/AS02 malaria vaccine and were undergoing experimental challenge with mosquito-borne falciparum malaria were examined to identify markers associated with protection.","obi_id":"OBI:0001982","obi_label":"protection from challenge in vivo intervention experiment"},{"name_in_paper":"gene expression profiling","quote":"Prediction analysis of microarrays identified genes corresponding with protection.","obi_id":"OBI:0001463","obi_label":"transcription profiling by array assay"},{"name_in_paper":"GeneChip analysis","quote":"Preparation of cellular RNA and subsequent processing for GeneChip analysis were performed as described elsewhere [28], by use of the HG-U133 A 2.0 and HG-U133 Plus 2.0 GeneChips (Affymetrix) and the Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer system (Agilent Technologies), to assess the integrity and quantity of RNA.","obi_id":"OBI:0001463","obi_label":"transcription profiling by array assay"},{"name_in_paper":"real-time polymerase chain reaction","quote":"To confirm observations from the gene chip data, TaqMan Gene Expression Assays (Applied Biosystems) were used to detect genes in the immunoproteosome pathway (PSME2, PSMB9, PSMB6, and PSMA4) in 3 randomly chosen samples from protected and nonprotected persons, at 2 weeks after the third vaccination.","obi_id":"OBI:0000911","obi_label":"real time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction assay"},{"name_in_paper":"detection of parasite in malaria thick blood smears","quote":"Infection with malaria was determined by detection of parasite in malaria thick blood smears during the 30 days after challenge.","obi_id":"OBI:0003038","obi_label":"parasite detection assay"}]}
